The Router missed noting the 'compression' artifact identified by the perceptual_quality_auditor (severity 0.4), which adds to the low-fidelity look. The topology mask shows a clean boundary, but the internal structure of the device (specifically the button gaps) is weak. I would upgrade the screen artifact severity to 2.5 because it represents a semantic failure (no OS) rather than just a texture issue.
